event.selection_basis: USGS documents Central Midwest flooding from rainfall and snowmelt. NOAA NCEI Storm Events 813204 supplies a county-scoped observed flood report in Custer County, Nebraska. This snowmelt/rain-on-snow river-flood mechanism is distinct from the rain-dominant candidates.
exclusions: The NOAA report establishes observed county flood occurrence, not a county-wide precipitation series.
uncertainties: No matched EAGLE-I outage coverage has been established, so this remains a candidate.

source_receipts.timezone_conversion: Alert publication time is EDT; catalog windows are UTC.
source_receipts.filters: Candidate discovery: rainfall and snowmelt flooding, March 2019; no county-row extraction.
source_receipts.grid_index_mapping: County FIPS only; no physical-grid mapping.
gaps: The alert is regional and streamgage-based, not county weather or outage evidence.

source_receipts.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
source_receipts.units: Storm Events local civil time fields; event report
source_receipts.timezone_conversion: CST-6 begin 13-MAR-19 16:23 is 2019-03-13T22:23:00Z; the report interval is retained in UTC.
source_receipts.grid_index_mapping: Census 2024 county FIPS 31041; no physical-grid mapping.
gaps: Storm Events is a county report, not an exhaustive weather time series.

event_report.limitations: The county Flood report documents observed flooding from snow, rain, and rapid snowmelt; it is not a complete county precipitation series.

weather.notes: County-scoped authoritative event evidence, with no invented sample count.

outage.notes: Full-file EAGLE-I result is pending; missing rows are not zeros.
